instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Atlas Innovations is a growing restaurant chain operating 12 Mediterranean-style locations. Their operational model relies heavily on centralized kitchen efficiency, managing supply chains for fresh ingredients, and leveraging technology to streamline front-of-house service delivery.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has invested significantly in its digital infrastructure over the last three years, including a full ERP migration and establishing a data warehouse. They have successfully implemented RPA for routine tasks and expanded their self-service BI tools, resulting in measurable operational cost savings.
answers.strategicGoals: The primary goal is to reverse the decline in customer retention by modernizing digital platforms and proactively eliminating churn drivers. This requires rapidly improving the ease of ordering, loyalty management, and personalized service experiences across all locations.
answers.additionalContext: Operating in a highly competitive micro-segment of the restaurant industry, Atlas must maintain operational excellence while continuously innovating to justify premium pricing and secure loyalty against larger chains.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.

opportunities.title: KDS Optimization via Predictive Analytics
opportunities.rationale: Implementing AI-driven quantity forecasting for prep and ordering minimizes food waste and labor costs immediately. This leverages existing data infrastructure to achieve quick operational efficiencies within the current short time horizon.

first_actions: Integrate BI dashboards with sales data streams
Pilot AI forecasting tool on one central kitchen location
resources_needed: Subscription fee for specialized forecasting software ($5k)
execution_plan.success_metric: 12% reduction in food waste within 6 months
milestones: Q1: Finalize vendor selection and data pipeline setup
Q2: Full rollout of AI-driven prep scheduling across the chain

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized Reservation Platform (Concept)
opportunities.rationale: Develop a novel, mobile-first reservation and loyalty system that offers real-time menu customization and personalized offers based on past informal interactions. This radical shift addresses customer stagnation directly by creating an experience larger competitors cannot easily replicate.

first_actions: Define core feature set (e.g., dynamic pricing, mobile ordering integration)
Run a high-fidelity prototype/MVP with 50 key customers
resources_needed: External development agency contract for MVP build ($30k)
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in repeat customer visits by 15% within the pilot group
milestones: Q1: Finalize product specifications and backend architecture
Q2-Q3: Launch controlled beta program for initial testing

next_steps.action: Establish a cross-functional task force to prioritize the 'Hyper-Personalized Reservation Platform' concept.
Conduct talent gap analysis and secure seed funding for a dedicated, part-time Head of Innovation role.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated R&D personnel leading to reactive innovation cycles.
Budget constraints (17% allocation) limiting large-scale, bold initiatives.
Over-reliance on informal customer feedback, making strategic shifts slow and unpredictable.
